exchange-smartlink-spares-contract-wire.text: A group of tug operators has awarded Smartlink a point-defence service contract. Port Yangshan yard crews expect more work on older cannon suites while the new order is filled.
exchange-smartlink-spares-contract-wire.title: Smartlink report

exchange-smartlink-cannon-inspection-wir.text: A safety inspection has delayed delivery of a Smartlink cannon assembly at Cassini Spaceport. The inspection is continuing, and the shipyard has not named a new delivery date.
exchange-smartlink-cannon-inspection-wir.title: Smartlink report

exchange-smartlink-surge-wire.text: Smartlink shares made a sharp move on the Lodestar Exchange. The desk has no single contract to point to; the market has been brisk all week.
exchange-smartlink-surge-wire.title: Smartlink price move

exchange-smartlink-slump-wire.text: Smartlink shares fell sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Buyers are waiting for the next station report before they call the bottom.
exchange-smartlink-slump-wire.title: Smartlink price move

exchange-testudo-cabin-refit-wire.text: Testudo has won a run of cabin refits for working haulers at Cloudbreak. The yard is splitting the work between several crews to keep the ships in service.
exchange-testudo-cabin-refit-wire.title: Testudo report

exchange-testudo-foundry-check-wire.text: Testudo has paused one foundry line for a crack inspection. The company has not said how many hull orders will be delayed while the check is under way.
exchange-testudo-foundry-check-wire.title: Testudo report

exchange-testudo-surge-wire.text: Testudo shares climbed sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. A strong week at the yards is not a delivery schedule, so the brokers are watching for the next order book.
exchange-testudo-surge-wire.title: Testudo price move

exchange-testudo-slump-wire.text: Testudo shares fell sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Several yards are holding their next orders until the station market settles.
exchange-testudo-slump-wire.title: Testudo price move

exchange-ayotimiwa-hull-auction-wire.text: K-Leg's latest salvage auction has drawn more independent buyers than expected. Crews are lining up for hull plate and usable fittings, though the yard has not changed its terms.
exchange-ayotimiwa-hull-auction-wire.title: Ayotimiwa Corp. report

exchange-ayotimiwa-yard-delay-wire.text: A failure in yard equipment has delayed departures from K-Leg. The Port Authority says crews are being routed around the damaged bay while repairs continue.
exchange-ayotimiwa-yard-delay-wire.title: Ayotimiwa Corp. report

exchange-ayotimiwa-surge-wire.text: Ayotimiwa shares rose sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. K-Leg's name is in every dockside conversation, but the desk has not tied the move to one auction.
exchange-ayotimiwa-surge-wire.title: Ayotimiwa Corp. price move

exchange-ayotimiwa-slump-wire.text: Ayotimiwa shares fell sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. The yard is still open; brokers are waiting to see how the next lots move.
exchange-ayotimiwa-slump-wire.title: Ayotimiwa Corp. price move

exchange-green-energy-cigarette-run-wire.text: The Green Energy Company has filled a large Damask Rose order for station stores. Merchants at Tharsis Landing say the delivery arrived in time for the next supply run.
exchange-green-energy-cigarette-run-wire.title: The Green Energy Company report

exchange-green-energy-seed-recall-wire.text: The Green Energy Company has recalled a seed lot after a storage failure. Growers are checking their stock while replacement consignments are arranged.
exchange-green-energy-seed-recall-wire.title: The Green Energy Company report

exchange-green-energy-surge-wire.text: Green Energy Company shares climbed sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Store orders have been lively, though nobody at the Tharsis board can name a single cause.
exchange-green-energy-surge-wire.title: The Green Energy Company price move

exchange-green-energy-slump-wire.text: Green Energy Company shares fell sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Traders are holding for the next shipment report before they change their plans.
exchange-green-energy-slump-wire.title: The Green Energy Company price move

exchange-brightvein-new-seam-wire.text: Brightvein has reported a clean ore seam and added a second carrier to the route. Zhonghuamen Terminal expects the first lot after the next belt run.
exchange-brightvein-new-seam-wire.title: Brightvein Mining report

exchange-brightvein-hauler-damage-wire.text: Damage to a Brightvein hauler has delayed an ore delivery to Zhonghuamen Terminal. The cargo is safe, but the company has not given a replacement arrival date.
exchange-brightvein-hauler-damage-wire.title: Brightvein Mining report

exchange-brightvein-surge-wire.text: Brightvein shares made a sharp move on the Lodestar Exchange. The board has no confirmed seam report to explain it; crews are still checking the latest cargo sheets.
exchange-brightvein-surge-wire.title: Brightvein Mining price move

exchange-brightvein-slump-wire.text: Brightvein shares dropped sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. A full ore bin is not a promise that the next buyer will be nearby.
exchange-brightvein-slump-wire.title: Brightvein Mining price move

exchange-coldwell-ice-delivery-wire.text: Coldwell has completed a water-ice run after a long delay at the docks. Stores at Port Yangshan have begun clearing the waiting orders.
exchange-coldwell-ice-delivery-wire.title: Coldwell Volatiles report

exchange-coldwell-tanker-repair-wire.text: A tanker repair has kept one of Coldwell's volatile cargoes off the route. Upsilon Docking is looking for a replacement load while the ship remains in the bay.
exchange-coldwell-tanker-repair-wire.title: Coldwell Volatiles report

exchange-coldwell-surge-wire.text: Coldwell shares rose sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Ice stores are moving again at Port Yangshan, but the desk has not linked the price change to one shipment.
exchange-coldwell-surge-wire.title: Coldwell Volatiles price move

exchange-coldwell-slump-wire.text: Coldwell shares slid sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Brokers are asking for the next arrival report before they take a view on the route.
exchange-coldwell-slump-wire.title: Coldwell Volatiles price move

exchange-verdemorrow-garden-orders-wire.text: Verdemorrow has received a new run of orders for shipboard cultivation equipment. Buyers at Qincheng Station say more crews are making room for a small grow rack between cargo runs.
exchange-verdemorrow-garden-orders-wire.title: Verdemorrow report

exchange-verdemorrow-stock-check-wire.text: A storage failure has delayed part of Verdemorrow's planting-stock shipment. The company is checking the affected containers before they leave the depot.
exchange-verdemorrow-stock-check-wire.title: Verdemorrow report

exchange-verdemorrow-surge-wire.text: Verdemorrow shares climbed sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Grow-room orders are up at Qincheng Station, though the market has not named them as the cause.
exchange-verdemorrow-surge-wire.title: Verdemorrow price move

exchange-verdemorrow-slump-wire.text: Verdemorrow shares fell sharply on the Lodestar Exchange. Buyers are checking the next planting-stock delivery before they call the season.
exchange-verdemorrow-slump-wire.title: Verdemorrow price move

exchange-halewright-clinic-orders-wire.text: Halewright has filled a run of clinic orders from outer-system stations. Qiantangmen's buyers expect the next shipment to include beds and replacement fittings.
exchange-halewright-clinic-orders-wire.title: Halewright report

exchange-halewright-fitting-recall-wire.text: Halewright has delayed a shipment while it checks a batch of clinic fittings. The company has asked customers to hold the affected boxes until the inspection is complete.
exchange-halewright-fitting-recall-wire.title: Halewright report

exchange-halewright-surge-wire.text: Halewright shares moved sharply higher on the Lodestar Exchange. Clinic buyers have been active, but the board has not named one order as the cause.
exchange-halewright-surge-wire.title: Halewright price move

exchange-halewright-slump-wire.text: Halewright shares moved sharply lower on the Lodestar Exchange. Station clinics still need supplies; the next freight report will tell more than the gossip.
exchange-halewright-slump-wire.title: Halewright price move

exchange-advert-verdemorrow.title: Verdemorrow grow-room supplies
exchange-advert-verdemorrow.text: Keep a little food close at hand. Verdemorrow fits cultivation racks, cookers and planting stock for working ships. A grow room still needs light, water, space and someone to tend it.

exchange-advert-halewright.title: Halewright clinic fittings
exchange-advert-halewright.text: A cramped sickbay can still be kept in order. Halewright supplies beds and practical clinic equipment for crews who have to treat a hurt spacer before the next station call.

exchange-advert-brightvein.title: Brightvein ore runs
exchange-advert-brightvein.text: Ore only earns its keep once it reaches a buyer. Brightvein runs regular belt cargo when the route, the hold and the dock queue all line up.

exchange-advert-coldwell.title: Coldwell sealed cargo
exchange-advert-coldwell.text: Water ice and industrial volatiles travel better when the cargo stays sealed. Coldwell hauls the cold loads through the inner routes and keeps the paperwork with the tanks.

exchange-advert-lodestar.title: Read the Lodestar board
exchange-advert-lodestar.text: Sela Nkomo, Lodestar market desk: Shortages, full bins and long waits at the docks all reach the share board in time. Read the station reports, mind the run you can afford, and remember that a share is not a wage.

exchange-how-to-read-the-board.label: Reading the share board
exchange-how-to-read-the-board.title: The Lodestar Exchange
exchange-how-to-read-the-board.body:
The Lodestar Exchange puts public companies on one board so crews can follow a share from one station to the next. Brokers, yard buyers, ship owners and the occasional spacer all trade there. A share is a small claim on a company; it does not buy you a berth, a cargo or a say over its daily work.

Start with the company page and the station markets it follows. A short supply of something a company sells may help it; a shortage of something it buys may hurt. The broader market, the company's sector and its own trend can pull the other way, and a story flag can add a lasting move. The market wire reports large changes, but a good report is still only one part of the picture. A ship needs fuel and stores before it can wait for a price to turn.

message.text: I saw your name enter Smartlink's public register. A share is a claim on the company, not a berth in its armoury; the people at the yard still have their own work to finish.
Your holding now stands out on my working copy of the register. That can make a sale slower to place when the board is thin. Check the market report before you make plans around it.
Your Testudo holding is on the public register now. The company builds useful ships, but you still need a yard slot, a crew and supplies before a hull can earn its keep.
The register shows you as one of Testudo's larger outside holders. Keep a little room in your plans: yard orders can arrive in a rush and then go quiet.
Your Ayotimiwa holding is entered on the public register. Shares do not reserve a salvage berth; when you bring a ship to K-Leg, the yard still deals with the ship in front of it.
Your Ayotimiwa position is now large enough for the register to flag it. K-Leg has no shortage of people with opinions about the yard; keep your plans tied to what you can actually see.

message.text: Your name is on the public register. That gives you a stake in the Green Energy Company; it does not put you in the Rosebud's crew or change what its stores can sell.

message.text: The register marks you as a substantial outside holder in the Green Energy Company. Judge it by deliveries and station demand, not by the noise around the name.

message.text: Your name is on Brightvein's register. We move ore when the route and the buyers line up; owning a share will not put a new load in your hold.
The register shows a large outside position in Brightvein. Ore work can be lumpy, so keep enough room in your plans for a quiet run.
Your Coldwell holding is on the register. We make a living by moving sealed cargo when a ship and a buyer are both ready; the shares do not reserve a tank.
We have a large outside holding to note on the register. The useful question is still whether our next cargo reaches a buyer before the next dock bill comes due.
Glad to see your name on our share register. If your crew is thinking about a garden, our Firstlight racks and Continuance planting stock still need a habitable room and regular care.
Your holding is one of the larger names on our register. We build useful equipment, but a share cannot grow a crop for you; the room and the crew still matter.
Your Halewright holding is on the public register. The company sells equipment, not a staffed clinic; a crew still has to make room and look after the gear.
The register shows you among Halewright's larger outside holders. Clinic orders can be steady until one missing shipment stops the work, so watch the stores as well as the board.

lodestar-first-board.title: A note from the Lodestar desk

message.text: Welcome to the Lodestar board. Each company page tells you which station markets it follows; check those reports before you buy. The wider market, the sector and the company trend can all pull a price in different directions. My line is a record of what happened, not a promise about the next move.
